entities.summary: Braslaw Lakes is one of the four national parks in Belarus. The national park was set up in September 1995. It is a unique ecosystem with a number of lakes and a large area of pine forests. Spanning an area of about 700 km2 (270 sq mi), the national park includes 30 lakes. The three largest lakes are Dryvyaty, Snudy and Strusta.
